caption: The ambient lighting has brightened. The white cylindrical object on the left side of the floor against the wall, which was previously placed vertically, is now folded and placed flat on the bed. The light blue mat that was previously rolled up at the foot of the bed has been unfolded and placed flat on the bed. The dark blue mat that was previously rolled up at the foot of the bed has been unfolded and placed flat on the bed. The light brown rectangular cushion that was previously placed vertically at the foot of the bed has been replaced with a gray rectangular cushion. A new cartoon tiger pattern blanket has appeared on the folded blankets at the foot of the bed.
The stool on the left side of the scene has disappeared, and the color of the stool on the right side has changed from brown to green.
The dog has turned to the right and is now facing away from the camera, with its head lowered towards the grass.
The three people in the image change from leaning to the left, with their arms extended and legs bent, to standing upright with their hands on their hips, legs crossed, and heads turned to the right.

The yellow toy bulldozer on the right side of the gray stool has been replaced by a red and white toy car. The blue and white police car in front of the bus has moved to the left side of the large toy bus. A new red and white toy truck with black tires has appeared in the position previously occupied by the yellow toy bulldozer.

The three people have changed from leaning forward with their heads resting on each other's shoulders to standing upright with one leg raised, hands on hips. The person in the middle now has their left hand on the shoulder of the person on the right.
A new pink bottle appears in the center of the scene.
The dog has turned to the right and is looking at something in the distance. The background wall has changed from yellow to gray.

A person wearing a white T-shirt and black shorts appears in front of the electric car, leaning against the electric car with their back to the camera, looking down at their phone. The yellow electric car on the left side of the frame moves forward one meter.
The three people in the middle of the formation change from having their right hand on their chest and their left hand extended forward to having both hands extended to the sides.
The dog has lowered its head and is sniffing the ground.
A new train toy has appeared in front of the toy car on the left side of the scene.
